直接回答

本轮证据不能测出全国申请人成功率，也不能证明审批严格程度的趋势。申请、批准与放款金额可描述活动，但没有同一申请群组的分母，不能推算获批概率。

直接回答仅覆盖注明的机制或已取到的观察；不证明当前所选国家的全部情况，不作个人获批承诺。

证据与数据

公开来源已读取；本页是受控答案设计，不是自由输入问答能力验收。

来源：DOSM；CC BY4.0。2026-10-20取样的历史修订版，各观察首发日未保留。仅说明价格篮子，不证明贷款审批严格程度。

全国申请成功率：不可测量。缺少相同申请群组的可比申请与批准件数。

为什么会这样
1. 政策与市场利率
2. 银行资金与风险
3. 贷款价格、标准与需求
4. 住房交易与投资
5. 建筑与关联工作
6. 家庭住房与消费

顺序表示阅读路径，不证明每条因果或所有国家都有相同传导。

生活中意味着什么

核对自己的住房合同、必要开销、收入余量与可调整空间。公共指标不能代替个人贷款报价或获批决定。

地区与历史比较
同看定义，不排列获批率
地区	可用本地指标	统一获批率
马来西亚	申请／批准金额	不可比；缺同口径分母
美国	银行标准／需求问卷与年度行动	不可比；缺同口径分母
中国	开发商收到按揭资金	不可比；缺同口径分母
日本	隔夜市场利率与住房调查	不可比；缺同口径分母
欧元区	银行贷款标准与需求净比例	不可比；缺同口径分母
英国	扣除取消后的批准笔数	不可比；缺同口径分母
无法证实的部分

本地同口径审批概率、完整房贷利率及房价／租金／就业的联动未齐。发布日缺失、许可待核和网络错误分别保留。没有“全球危机评分”。

Structure & history
Compare & change
Short answer

The collected evidence cannot measure a national applicant success probability or prove a trend in strictness. Applications, approvals and disbursements by amount can help describe activity, but without a matched application cohort they cannot answer that probability.

The answer covers the stated mechanism or collected observation only. It does not establish every current local condition or promise an individual approval.

Evidence & data

Public sources were read. This is a curated answer design, not acceptance of free-input answering.

Inspect observation table (scroll horizontally)
Malaysia residential-purpose loans: monthly amounts (MYR billion)

Applied · Approved · Disbursed

Source: Bank Negara Malaysia / official CCRIS aggregates. Original MYR divided by1billion; same-month flows are not a matched application cohort. No approval probability is calculated. Initial release dates not retained; retrieved2026-10-20.

Malaysia2024: monthly overall CPI,2010=100
135

01

Source:DOSM;CC BY4.0. Historical revised vintage sampled2026-10-20; initial release dates not retained. Basket prices do not establish mortgage approval strictness.

National applicant success probability: not measurable. Matched application-cohort counts are unavailable.

How the mechanism can work
1. Policy & market rates
2. Bank funding & risk
3. Loan prices, standards & demand
4. Housing transactions & investment
5. Construction & related jobs
6. Household housing & spending

The sequence guides reading; it does not establish every causal link or uniform transmission across countries.

What this means in daily life

Check your housing contract, necessary costs, income margin and room to adjust. Public indicators do not replace a personal loan offer or approval decision.

Places & historical comparison
Compare definitions; no approval-rate ranking
Place	Local metric	Harmonised approval rate
Malaysia	Application / approved amounts	Not comparable; aligned denominator absent
United States	Bank surveys and annual reported actions	Not comparable; aligned denominator absent
China	Mortgage funds received by developers	Not comparable; aligned denominator absent
Japan	Overnight market rate and housing surveys	Not comparable; aligned denominator absent
Euro area	Net bank standards and demand	Not comparable; aligned denominator absent
United Kingdom	Approvals net of cancellations	Not comparable; aligned denominator absent
What remains unproven

Aligned local approval probabilities, complete mortgage rates and housing/rent/jobs relationships are incomplete. Missing release dates, licence gaps and network errors stay distinct. No global crisis score is produced.
